page.content:
Composer, lyricist, and original Hamilton who wrote the score from Chernow.

How Lin-Manuel Miranda connects

  • Work: Hamilton (musical) — Lin-Manuel Miranda wrote the book, music, and lyrics of Hamilton.
  • Topic: Hamilton — Lin-Manuel Miranda is the author-star at the center of Hamilton.
  • Character: Alexander Hamilton — Miranda originated Alexander Hamilton on stage.

What is Lin-Manuel Miranda?

Lin-Manuel Miranda wrote the book, music, and lyrics of Hamilton, originated the title role Off-Broadway and on Broadway, and turned Chernow's Alexander Hamilton into a sung-through cabinet and duel.

Key threads lead to Hamilton (musical), Hamilton and Alexander Hamilton.
